rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for instructing or teaching someone in everyday Cantonese.

example.english: I’ll educate you on how to use this machine.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 joeng6 jung6 ni1 bou6 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically when educate means to train someone in practical or professional skills.

example.english: The company will educate new employees in using this software.
example.traditional: 公司會培訓新員工用呢套軟件。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 pui4 fan3 san1 jyun4 gung1 jung6 ni1 tou3 jyun5 gin6

rows.note: Use this for the broader or more formal process of educating people, especially about social or academic topics.

example.english: Schools have a responsibility to educate students to respect others.
example.traditional: 學校有責任教育學生尊重別人。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gaau3 juk6 hok6 saang1 zyun1 zung6 bit6 jan4
